The CRA Board voted to offer the CRA Executive Director position to K. Stephen Cox, II, on August 17, 2021, with an effective date of September 27, 2021. The employment agreement provided for an annual salary of $100,000.00, severance pay of 20 weeks as authorized by Florida Statutes, Section 215.425, and the same benefits provided to executive management staff of the City of Tallahassee. The agreement also included approval of reasonable relocation expenses, in accordance with City Personnel Policy 702 and practice. The terms of the existing employment contract are for an initial period of five (5) years with an automatic renewal at the expiration of the initial term for an additional two (2) years unless notice that the Agreement shall not be renewed is given by the Board or by the employee at least six (6) months before the expiration of the initial term.
